naf812d01e5.headline: Lasquetty emphasizes the Government's intention to lower the IRPF by half a point during the legislature
naf812d01e5.summary: The Finance Minister of the Community of Madrid emphasized the government's intention to lower the IRPF personal income tax rate by half a point during the legislature.
naf812d01e5.why: Tax reductions can increase disposable income and stimulate consumption and investment in the Madrid region.

nd67e5dbf76.headline: Hetmantsev Explained How Zelensky Will Force Ukrainians to Take Money Out from Under the Mattress with the Tax Amnesty Law - sud.ua
nd67e5dbf76.summary: Ukraine’s government plans to encourage citizens to declare and use previously undeclared money through a new tax amnesty law, requiring funds to be taken out of informal storage.
nd67e5dbf76.why: Mobilizing undeclared savings into the formal economy can increase tax revenues and liquidity, supporting economic stability and growth.
